title: Member of Technical Staff Engineering
description:
Overview

Physical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering.

Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit.

The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.

We have one product: new physics, at scale.

Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact.

Â 

Role and Responsibilities

  • Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

  • The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

  • Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

  • We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit.

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials.

  • Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list.

  • You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently.

  • A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically.

Nice to Have

  • Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security.

  • Experience in research or scientific computing environments.

  • Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem.

Â 

How We Work

We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage.

Â 

Location and Compensation

This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.

title: Brand Protection & Marketplace Compliance Analyst
description:
Position Type: Full-time

Location: Philippines (Remote)

Schedule: Mon-Fri, EST

About the Company

Our client is a global leader in swimming pool technology, specializing in robotic pool cleaners, pool safety products, water treatment solutions, and related pool equipment for residential and commercial customers. With a strong international presence and a network of distributors, subsidiaries, and partners across multiple markets, our client serves customers worldwide through a variety of sales and distribution channels.

About the Role

Our client is looking for a Brand Protection & Marketplace Compliance Analyst to monitor online marketplaces and digital channels across North America and Europe. The role focuses on identifying unauthorized sellers, marketplace and distribution violations, misuse of brand assets, and other compliance issues.

You will conduct online research, analyze seller and product data, maintain accurate records, and prepare reports that provide actionable insights to the business.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor Amazon, eBay, Walmart, BestBuy, Home Depot, AliExpress, Temu, and other major marketplaces.

  • Research products and identify new or unauthorized sellers.

  • Classify sellers and verify their authorization status.

  • Identify MAP, distribution, territory, and marketplace compliance issues.

  • Monitor unauthorized use of logos, images, trademarks, and product content.

  • Collect evidence such as URLs, screenshots, seller information, and product details.

  • Maintain accurate seller databases and internal records.

  • Prepare daily reports and monthly Voice of Consumer reports.

  • Build and maintain dashboards tracking brand-protection metrics.

  • Identify opportunities to improve research and reporting processes.

Competencies and Qualifications


Must-Have

  • 3+ years of experience in data analysis, online research, e-commerce, compliance, or a related field.

  • Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables.

  • Strong research, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.

  • Strong written English and reporting skills.

  • Ability to work independently and follow SOPs.

  • Familiarity with Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces.

Nice-to-Have

  • Brand protection or marketplace compliance experience.

  • Experience with PROWL, Helium 10, Salesforce, or similar tools.

  • Knowledge of MAP, distribution, or channel compliance.

  • Experience with dashboards and reporting.

  • Experience using AI research and translation tools.

Key Qualities

  • Detail-oriented

  • Analytical

  • Investigative

  • Highly organized

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work â Work from anywhere in the Philippines.

  • Career Growth Opportunities â Gain hands-on experience, and continuous learning.

  • Collaborative & Innovative Team â Work alongside skilled professionals who value excellence.

Application Process

We understand that searching for a new job can be challenging, and weâre here to support you every step of the way. Our goal is to make the process as transparent and respectful as possible.

The interview process includes a Recruiter Interview, Client Interview, and Assessment. As part of the process, candidates complete a hands-on task during the technical interview. Throughout each stage, we keep you informed and provide feedback as quickly as possible, ensuring you feel valued and supported throughout your journey with us.

title: Engineering Manager Thailand
description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future

Â 

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology â setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality â when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Â 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

description:
Crystalia Glass LLC is a leading provider of premium glass products, dedicated to transforming spaces with elegance and sophistication. With a commitment to craftsmanship and innovation, we specialize in designing and manufacturing high-quality glass solutions for residential and commercial projects.

Founded in 2017 in New York, the company has expanded its presence with offices in Los Angeles, Florida, and Texas. As a nationwide company, we serve clients across America, offering our signature glass products and services to diverse markets.

Following consistent annual growth of 70-80% and with even more ambitious plans ahead, we are expanding our recruitment team and looking for a Cost Engineer-Estimator to help drive our continued success.

Employment Type:

  • Full-time, 8:30 AM - 5:00 PM, New York time
  • Remote work.

Responsibilities:

  • Review architectural drawings and submitted quotes to determine suitable installation options for our systems, including glass, aluminum, and steel partitions
  • Perform precise take-offs for all door and partition openings based on architectural and shop drawings
  • Read and interpret door schedules and hardware sets to ensure accurate product selection and full compatibility
  • Communicate effectively with the sales team to clarify project scope, technical requirements, and deadlines
  • Request necessary documentation, including compliance and regulatory certifications, as needed
  • Prepare detailed quotes that clearly define included materials, scope of work, exclusions, and any relevant assumptions or conditions
  • Identify and correct technical errors made by sales managers and propose appropriate alternatives or solutions

Requirements

  • Technical degree in Mechanical or Civil/Structural Engineering
  • Strong spatial thinking and technical problem-solving skills
  • Proven experience with quantity take-offs from construction and mechanical drawings
  • Confident in reading and interpreting:
  • Civil and mechanical drawings Hardware sets and layouts
  • Proficient in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Basic formulas
  • High attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and work independently
  • Comfortable working with scaled PDFs (e.g., in Adobe Acrobat)
  • Languages: Russian (fluent), English (Upper-intermediate B2)
  • Available to work full-time aligned with EST timezone (8:30AM-5:00PM)

Benefits

  • Clear opportunities for career development and salary increase
  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Work with a diverse and talented group of professionals
  • Supportive and innovative work environment
  • Paid days off and Sick leave

Please note: this is a fully remote, full-time position with a schedule from 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM (New York time).

The candidate should have strong written and verbal English communication skills (B2 level or higher) and a technical degree or proven experience as a Engineer / Estimator.

title: Surveyor I
description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. Weâre at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Equal Opportunity

ABS Bureau is committed to the equal employment opportunity of its employees and prohibits discrimination against any employee or qualified applicant based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status, or other non-work-related characteristics that may be protected under the law of the Federal Government or specific state employment laws.

ABS and Affiliated Companies (ABS) will not pay a fee to any third-party agency without a valid ABS Master Service Agreement (MSA) authorized and signed by Human Resources. Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

Other

title: Why do you want this new job
description:
No matter which side of the table youâve sat during interviews, youâve probably heard this question: âWhy do you want this new job?â

In the recent past, Iâve interviewed a few candidates and heard the following answers so far:

  • Iâm not learning much on the current job after itâs been 2-4 years.
  • Iâm looking for something that offers better work-life balance.
  • Iâm not really looking for a job. The recruiters got in touch and I thought Iâd discuss.
  • Iâm looking for more challenging work.

All of the above are valid answers. I think thereâs another perfectly valid answer that candidates seldom mention probably due to the gravity of the interview room situation. Iâve interviewed over a hundred candidates across different companies and am yet to find anyone that mentions: I am not happy with my current salary and benefits compared to my skills

Back to topic of answers. So, when someone answers that they are not learning new things on the job, obviously, youâd be curios to know why and how they have tried to change things. Unfortunately, most candidates simply mention that they are doing repeat work and thereâs not much to learn doing the same thing over and over again. This is where I start feeling a little uneasy. However, I understand that itâs a true statement. If youâre in a similar situation, hereâs some suggestion: read books, and write code based on what youâve read. Then, you can tell a much convincing story that, Iâve forced myself to learn new things and hereâs some proof, but I really want to apply the newly learned skills outside the scope of the âhello worldâ skills.

About work-life balance, I totally hear you. And if your current job doesnât suit what you need out of your life, itâs a perfectly valid reason to look for new opportunities. However, make sure youâre able to clearly set the expectation with your potential employer about what work-life balance means for you. For example, if you canât work over 40 hours a week, or must work from home one-two days a week, itâs best to discuss this even before an interview starts to ensure youâre a good match with the employer.

If you showed up at in interview just because a recruiter got in touch, Iâd say introspect first. Itâs possible that on our subconcious mind you have expectations that the potential of the new job offers you something that you donât get at the current job. So, instead of a passive asnwer that the you simply acted based on the recruiterâs invite, itâs much convincing to see if you can lay down one or two things that you expect from the new job that you donât get at the current job.

About looking for more challenge, it sounds like a cliche unless you can share examples of work that is of challenging to you. May be you like the challenge of using more complicated algorithms, may be you like dealing with a lot of data, may be you like supporting production emergencies, but thereâs gotta be something that you can explicitly mention as challenging. It helps employers to understand if theyâre able to provide you with enough challenge on the job.

Finally, if youâre looking for a new job because the current job isnât paying upto the level of your skills and contributions, make sure to communicate it clearly as well. With salaries and benefits, I find it much easier to work with people that know the actual $ figure thatâll make them happy instead of beating around the bush to create confusions all around. Just be confident and tell what makes you happy. If the employer can afford it, most likely theyâll want to get you onboard as a happy employee. If they canât afford it, theyâll do their best. The key here is to be explicit about what you want and be sure and confident about it.

In a nutshell, when you walk into an interview itâs yours to lose. The potential employer is investing their time and resources and would rather have you hired than having to interview other candidates. As long as you are able to justify why you want the new job, theyâll be quite accommodating.

title: Head of Security
description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send payoutsâgift cards and moneyâto anyone, anywhere, instantly. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way, to reach millions of recipients worldwide.

We're profitable and growing without outside investors. We're fully remote, with a high-documentation, low-meeting culture that leaves more time for the work that mattersâand for your life outside it. Our employee NPS sits in the high 80s.

We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire.

About The Role

You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering, Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this.

What You'll Do

  • Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security.
  • Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation.
  • Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do.
  • Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."
  • Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it.
  • Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team.

What You'll Bring

  • Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth.
  • Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook.
  • An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code.
  • Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling.
  • Bedside manner. You drive hard change by bringing the team around to your point of view, rather than just telling them no. Engineers and the rest of the company want to work with you.
  • Experience building or co-building a small security team is a plus.
  • Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus.

What's Cool About The Role

  • You define the function. First security leader, with the budget for the required tools and team.
  • A real mandate. The push for this hire comes straight from the founders.
  • We invest in your tools. Everyone has a $5k/month budget for AI tools. Use it.
  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary $250,000â$330,000, plus meaningful equity.
  • Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.
  • Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

Compensation Range: $250K - $330K

title: Data Analyst Assistant
description:
About the role
 The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
  • Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
  • Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.


What we are looking for
  • A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
  • Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
  • Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
  • Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers
  • A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
  • Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
  • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
  • The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
  • Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

title: Data Entry Administrator
description:
About PulseMediaNL

PulseMediaNL is a forward-thinking digital media company committed to delivering high-quality content, innovative marketing solutions, and exceptional customer experiences. We value accuracy, efficiency, collaboration, and continuous improvement. As our team grows, we are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Data Entry Administrator to support our daily operations by maintaining accurate and reliable data across multiple platforms.

Position Overview

The Data Entry Administrator is responsible for accurately entering, updating, verifying, and maintaining company data while ensuring the highest standards of quality and confidentiality. This role requires excellent attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. The successful candidate will help ensure that business records remain complete, accurate, and accessible, contributing directly to operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Accurately enter data into company databases, spreadsheets, and internal management systems.
  • Review and verify information for completeness, accuracy, and consistency before submission.
  • Update existing records with new information while maintaining data integrity.
  • Identify and correct errors, inconsistencies, or duplicate entries.
  • Organize and maintain digital files, records, and documentation.
  • Perform routine data quality checks and audits.
  • Generate reports and summaries as requested by management.
  • Assist with importing and exporting data between various software platforms.
  • Maintain confidential information in accordance with company policies and applicable privacy regulations.
  • Collaborate with internal departments to obtain missing or updated information.
  • Prioritize tasks to meet deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
  • Support administrative projects and perform additional data-related tasks as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent; an associate's or bachelor's degree is an advantage.
  • Previous experience in data entry, administrative support, or office administration preferred.
  • Excellent typing skills with a high level of accuracy.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing error-free work.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and Word.
  • Experience using Google Workspace, including Google Sheets and Google Docs.
  • Comfortable learning and using new software and database systems.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote work environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CRM or ERP software.
  • Familiarity with database management systems.
  • Knowledge of data privacy and information security best practices.
  • Experience working remotely in a professional environment.
  • Basic analytical and problem-solving skills.

Key Skills

  • Data entry accuracy
  • Time management
  • Organization
  • Attention to detail
  • Communication
  • Problem-solving
  • Computer literacy
  • Multitasking
  • Confidentiality
  • Team collaboration

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Flexible working schedule where applicable.
  • Paid time off and company holidays.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Supportive and collaborative team culture.
  • Ongoing training and skill development.
  • Performance recognition and advancement opportunities.
  • Access to modern digital collaboration tools.

Success in This Role

The ideal candidate consistently delivers accurate work, meets deadlines, maintains confidentiality, communicates effectively with colleagues, and demonstrates a proactive approach to improving data quality and administrative processes.

Equal Opportunity Employer

PulseMediaNL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees are treated with respect and provided equal opportunities.

If you are a detail-oriented professional who enjoys working with data and thrives in a remote environment, we encourage you to apply and become part of the PulseMediaNL team.

Role Overview & Impact

The Human Resources Coordinator provides administrative and operational support across the Human Resources department. This entry-level position supports onboarding, employee records, HR system transactions, recruitment coordination, employee communications, and general HR department operations.

The HR Coordinator serves as an initial point of contact for routine employee and applicant questions and ensures that requests are directed to the appropriate HR team member. The successful candidate will be highly organized, service-oriented, comfortable using technology, and committed to maintaining the confidentiality and accuracy of employee information.

Key Responsibilities

Core Responsibilities

  • Assist with pre-employment requirements
  • Maintain accurate recruiting records and candidate files
  • Support job fairs, community outreach, internship activities, and recruiting events
  • Provide a professional, timely, and welcoming candidate experience

Onboarding & Offboarding

  • Coordinate pre-employment and onboarding activities after an offer has been accepted
  • Send new-hire forms, instructions, orientation schedules, and required notices
  • Track completion of pre-employment requirements, background checks, employment documents, and onboarding tasks
  • Coordinate the timely completion and retention of Form I-9 documentation in accordance with established procedures
  • Coordinate with hiring managers, Payroll, Information Technology, Learning and Development, and other departments to support new-hire readiness
  • Confirm that new employees receive appropriate system access, equipment information, schedules, and introductory materials
  • Support new-hire orientation logistics and attendance tracking
  • Follow up on incomplete forms or onboarding requirements

  • Schedule exit interviews or distribute exit questionnaires

HR Compliance & Documentation

  • Assist with personnel-file, I-9, benefits, training, and HR data audits
  • Track required documents, acknowledgments, certifications, and renewal dates
  • Assist with preparing records for internal and external audits
  • Follow established HR policies, procedures, record-retention requirements, and confidentiality standards

Oula Health is a venture-backed, midwifery-led maternity and GYN care company building the next generation of women's healthcare. The Role

At Oula, our product doesn't sit alongside our EHR â it integrates directly into it. Every product and engineering decision has downstream consequences for how our EHRs are configured, and every EHR configuration decision shapes what's possible on the product side. Someone has to hold both at once.

We're looking for a technically-minded Product Manager to own and evolve our core technology stack â including our EHR, patient portal, and care management platform. This role sits at the intersection of product, operations, and health system integration, serving as the internal and external subject matter expert on our EMR and the primary lead for health system EHR integrations.

You'll manage the day-to-day health of our tech stack, partnering closely with both internal teams and external health system stakeholders to ensure our systems run smoothly and our integrations deliver. Data & Reporting

What You Bring

What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days, you've audited our current Athena configuration, identified gaps, and have a remediation plan. You understand the bug triage process well enough to have improved it. You've met your counterparts at every health system partner and know what's coming for the next Epic integration.

At one year, the SOP library is comprehensive, clinical systems configuration is stable and documented, and you've successfully navigated at least one new health system EHR environment. The product team has a reliable partner and the ops team isn't dependent on any single person for systems knowledge.

title: Account Lead Influencer Marketing & Brand Strategy (m/w/d)
description:
Du arbeitest im Influencer Marketing und denkst manchmal: Da müsste eigentlich noch mehr gehen? Mehr Strategie. Mehr Verantwortung. Größere Marken. Größere Ideen. Ein eigenes Team. Und vor allem mehr Einfluss darauf, was am Ende wirklich passiert und was im besten Fall die Branche prägt?

Then keep reading. 👀

Ykone zählt zu den führenden Influencer Marketing Agenturen weltweit. Seit über 13 Jahren gestalten wir die Branche mit und arbeiten heute mit internationalen Top Brands aus Beauty, Fashion, Luxury, Lifestyle und Tech. Von München über Paris, Mailand und London bis Dubai verbinden unsere Teams lokale Expertise mit einem globalen Netzwerk.

In Deutschland sind wir gerade in einer besonders spannenden Phase: Wir wachsen, gewinnen große internationale Etats und entwickeln gleichzeitig weiter, wie Influencer Marketing in Zukunft funktioniert. Strategischer, kreativer, technologischer und skalierbarer.

Das macht Ykone zu einem Ort für Menschen, die mehr wollen als den nächsten Job. Die Verantwortung übernehmen, große Ideen vorantreiben, andere mitnehmen und wirklich Einfluss darauf haben wollen, was wir als Agentur und für unsere Kunden aufbauen.

Aufgaben

Wir suchen jemanden, der übernimmt. Als Account Lead Influencer Marketing & Brand Strategy verantwortest du mehrere unserer wichtigsten internationalen Kunden aus Beauty, Fashion, Lifestyle und Tech.

Du entwickelst ihre Influencer Strategie, berätst Marketing Leads auf Senior Level, führst große Pitches, entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team neue Konzepte und erkennst Business Potenziale, bevor der Kunde danach fragt.

Und: Du führst Menschen. Nicht im Sinne von Aufgaben verteilen und Status Calls führen. Sondern indem du Standards setzt, andere besser machst, challengest, inspirierst, Entscheidungen triffst und deinem Team zutraust, über sich hinauszuwachsen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Accounts führen: Du übernimmst die Gesamtverantwortung für mehrere unserer wichtigsten Kunden und bist strategische Ansprechpartner auf Senior Level. Du kennst ihr Business, ihre Herausforderungen und Ziele und denkst ihnen einen Schritt voraus.
  • Strategische Richtung vorgeben: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit Strategy und deinem Team Jahresstrategien und große Kampagnenideen, challengest bestehende Ansätze und stellst sicher, dass unsere Arbeit nicht nur kreativ überzeugt, sondern auf die Business- und Marketingziele unserer Kunden einzahlt.
  • Business entwickeln: Du erkennst Potenziale, bevor daraus ein Briefing entsteht. Du identifizierst neue Themen, Services und Budgets, entwickelst daraus konkrete Opportunities und baust bestehende Kundenbeziehungen strategisch weiter aus.
  • Pitches gewinnen: Du führst große Pitches und strategische Präsentationen federführend, entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Spezialist die richtige Story und überzeugst Kunden von unseren Ideen.
  • Teams führen und entwickeln: Du führst dein eigenes Account-Team, gibst Richtung und klare Standards vor und entwickelst Menschen weiter. Du musst nicht jede Aufgabe selbst lösen. Dein Job ist es, dein Team so gut zu machen, dass es Verantwortung übernehmen und über sich hinauswachsen kann.
  • Die richtigen Expert zusammenbringen: Influencer Marketing ist für uns längst mehr als klassische Kampagnen. Du verbindest deine Accounts mit unseren Expert aus Strategy, Creative, Events, Social, Paid und Scaled Campaigns und entwickelst daraus Lösungen, die unsere Kunden wirklich weiterbringen.
  • Wirtschaftliche Verantwortung übernehmen: Du steuerst Budgets und Ressourcen über deine Accounts hinweg, behältst Forecast, Profitabilität und Wachstum im Blick und triffst Entscheidungen mit unternehmerischem Verständnis.
  • Qualität verantworten: Du musst nicht in jedem Projekt operativ arbeiten, aber du bist dafür verantwortlich, dass Strategie, Kreation und Umsetzung unseren Anspruch erfüllen und Ergebnisse liefern.
  • YKONE mitgestalten: Du denkst über deine eigenen Accounts hinaus, bringst neue Ideen und Perspektiven ein, challengest uns als Agentur und hilfst dabei, unsere Services, Teams und Arbeitsweisen weiterzuentwickeln.

Qualifikation

Das könnte dein Job sein, wenn du ...

👀 Influencer Marketing nicht nur ausführst, sondern wirklich verstehst. Du bringst mindestens 5 Jahre relevante Vollzeit-Erfahrung auf Agentur- oder Brand-Seite mit und kennst die Branche, Creator, Managements und ihre Mechaniken.

🧠 Marken strategisch beraten willst, statt Briefings einfach abzuarbeiten. Du entwickelst Jahresstrategien, übersetzt Business- und Marketingziele in klare Influencer-Strategien und kannst deine Empfehlungen auch auf Senior-Level überzeugend vertreten.

🚀 Verantwortung nicht erst übernimmst, wenn sie dir jemand offiziell übergibt. Du hast bereits große Kunden und idealerweise siebenstellige Budgets verantwortet und fühlst dich wohl damit, Entscheidungen zu treffen und für Ergebnisse einzustehen.

🤝 aus guten Kundenbeziehungen langfristige Partnerschaften und neues Business machen kannst. Du erkennst Potenziale, denkst über das bestehende Briefing hinaus und hast Lust darauf, deine Accounts aktiv weiterzuentwickeln und wachsen zu lassen.

👥 Menschen nicht nur managen, sondern besser machen willst. Du hast bereits Teams oder Kolleg geführt und weiterentwickelt, kannst klare Erwartungen setzen, konstruktiv challengen und Verantwortung abgeben.

💡 Ideen hast, die nicht nur kreativ sind, sondern unsere Kunden weiterbringen. Du kannst unterschiedliche Perspektiven zusammenbringen, eine strategische Richtung vorgeben und aus einer ersten Idee eine überzeugende Story machen.

📱 TikTok, Instagram und YouTube auf Marketer-Level verstehst. Formate, Plattformmechaniken, Creator-Ecosystem und relevante Benchmarks gehören für dich zum Handwerkszeug und du interessierst dich dafür, was als Nächstes kommt.

📈 große Ziele eher motivierend als einschüchternd findest. Du willst nicht nur gute Kampagnen umsetzen, sondern Kunden, Teams und Business entwickeln und hast Lust darauf, an deinem eigenen Impact gemessen zu werden.

Und vielleicht am wichtigsten:

Du liebst diese Branche wirklich. Du bist neugierig auf das, was sich verändert, hast eine Meinung dazu, was gutes Influencer Marketing heute und morgen ausmacht, und willst die nächsten Jahre nicht nur dabei sein, sondern aktiv mitgestalten.

Benefits

  • Arbeit mit internationalen Top-Marken und Budgets, die wirklich etwas bewegen
  • Entscheidungsspielraum in deinen Accounts und direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung
  • Internationale Zusammenarbeit mit den YKONE-Teams in Paris, Mailand, London und weiteren Städten
  • Office First in München, aber mit Flexibilität: Homeoffice möglich, Remote ebenfalls, wenn es zu deiner Lebenssituation passt
  • 28 Urlaubstage, MacBook, iPhone, Egym/Wellfit-Mitgliedschaft

Aber deswegen solltest du den Job nicht machen.

Du solltest ihn machen, wenn du irgendwann auf die nächsten Jahre deiner Karriere zurückblicken und sagen willst: Ich habe nicht einfach tolle Accounts betreut. Ich habe etwas aufgebaut und mitgestaltet.

Klingt nach dir? Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

Kein Roman als Anschreiben nötig. Schick uns deinen CV und am liebsten 2 bis 3 Cases, auf die du wirklich stolz bist. Und sag uns, was daran dein Anteil war.

title: New Business Account Executive (DACH market)
description:
About The Role

Vivid Money is redefining how modern corporates, holding structures, and financial institutions manage and optimize their capital. From institutional-grade Treasury products (high-yield Interest Accounts, Money Market Funds, and ETFs) to multi-currency infrastructure and FX solutions, we provide the financial architecture that traditional banks make too slow and expensive.
We are expanding our institutional footprint in Germany.
We aren’t looking for a standard software sales rep; we are looking for a New Business Account Executive who understands the fabric of the German financial ecosystem. You will be employee number one on the ground, tasked with unlocking high-value segments: PE/VC funds, holding companies (Soparfis), family offices, and corporate service providers.
If you have the network to navigate corporate Germany, understand structured finance/treasury needs, and want the autonomy to build a market from scratch, this role is for you.


Your Mission

  • Originate Institutional Pipeline: Identify and engage decision-makers across Germanys unique B2B landscape, focusing on PE/VC funds, corporate holding structures, asset managers, and corporates.
  • Leverage Channel Partnerships: Build strategic relationships with local multipliers—accountants, tax advisors, law firms—who manage hundreds of entities requiring modern treasury setups.
  • Navigate Complex Sales Cycles: Run the end-to-end commercial cycle for high-value accounts, from sophisticated discovery and structured treasury pitches to compliance onboarding and closing.
  • Position Vivid as a Yield Partner: Educate fund managers and corporate treasurers on how to leverage Vivid’s Treasury and MMF solutions to optimize returns on their cash reserves and dry powder.
  • Shape the German Playbook: Partner directly with the Sales Leadership team to refine our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP), localized messaging, and regulatory positioning for the German market.
  • Represent the Brand: Act as the face of Vivid Money GmbH at major financial services, fund industry, and fintech events in Germany.


Your Profile

  • 5+ years of B2B/Institutional sales experience within the German financial ecosystem (e.g., Private Banking, Corporate Banking, Fund Services, FinTech, or Treasury/Asset Management).
  • Deep local knowledge: You thoroughly understand Germanys financial structures (Soparfis, RAIFs, SICAVs) and know how these entities manage liquidity and banking relationships.
  • An established network: You have an existing book of contacts or a proven ability to network into CFOs, Fund Operations leads, Managing Directors, and Domiciliation Agents.
  • Technical fluency: You can speak confidently about FX, money market funds, yield generation, and compliance/KYB processes for complex corporate structures.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset: You thrive in an "AI-first," high-autonomy environment where the playbook is yours to write.
  • Languages: Full professional fluency in English and German is required. 


Why Join Vivid?

  • Hybrid or remote way of work. You can work from our Berlin office or fully remote from other locations. 
  • Direct influence on go-to-market strategy and revenue growth. 
  • Significant ownership from day one and strong growth opportunities. 
  • AI-first culture – we use it every day, not just talk about it.
  • Learning & development budget to support your professional growth. 
  • Fully paid vacation and sick leave. 
  • Sports compensation. 
  • Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one.


Compensation range

Total target compensation: from €120,000 gross annually (base salary + performance-related bonus). Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills, and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria.


About Vivid

At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.

Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.

Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started.

We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

description:

Warum mute-labs?Bei mute-labs bringen wir Ruhe in moderne Arbeitswelten. Wir entwickeln und produzieren hochwertige Akustikkabinen, die Unternehmen dabei helfen, bessere Arbeitsbedingungen für ihre Teams zu schaffen.
Als eigenfinanziertes und profitables Unternehmen setzen wir auf nachhaltiges Wachstum und langfristige Zusammenarbeit. Du wirst Teil eines ambitionierten, internationalen Teams mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und viel Raum für Eigeninitiative.

Die Rolle: Qualifizierte Leads beraten und erfolgreich abschließenFür den DACH-Markt suchen wir einen Account Executive, der unsere eingehenden Leads vom ersten Gespräch bis zum Vertragsabschluss begleitet.
Der Schwerpunkt der Rolle liegt klar auf Inbound Sales: Du sprichst mit Unternehmen, die bereits Interesse an unseren Produkten gezeigt haben, verstehst ihre Bedürfnisse und entwickelst gemeinsam mit ihnen die passende Lösung.
Dabei verkaufst du nicht einfach nur Akustikkabinen. Du berätst Unternehmen in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz dabei, bessere und produktivere Arbeitsumgebungen zu schaffen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Inbound Lead Management: Du übernimmst qualifizierte Anfragen und bist die erste Ansprechperson für potenzielle Kund:innen im DACH-Markt.
  • Bedarfsanalyse: In Discovery Calls findest du heraus, welche Herausforderungen, Anforderungen und Entscheidungsprozesse auf Kundenseite bestehen.
  • Produktberatung und Demos: Du präsentierst unsere Lösungen überzeugend und entwickelst Angebote, die zum jeweiligen Unternehmen passen.
  • End-to-End Ownership: Du begleitest deine Deals eigenständig durch den gesamten Sales-Prozess – vom ersten Gespräch über die Verhandlung und das Follow-up bis zum Abschluss.
  • Pipeline Management: Du pflegst deine Opportunities zuverlässig im CRM, priorisierst deine nächsten Schritte und behältst deine Forecasts im Blick.
  • Proaktive Weiterentwicklung: Wenn es sinnvoll ist, sprichst du auch gezielt potenzielle Kund:innen an und entwickelst bestehende Kontakte weiter. Der Schwerpunkt bleibt jedoch klar auf Inbound Sales.
  • Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Sales-Team sowie mit Marketing, Customer Service und Operations zusammen und teilst deine Erkenntnisse aus Kundengesprächen.
So könnte dein Tag bei uns aussehen09:00 | Morning Vibe
Du startest gemeinsam mit dem Team in den Tag, holst dir einen Kaffee und überprüfst deine neuen Leads und offenen Follow-ups.
09:30 | Discovery Call
Du sprichst mit einem Unternehmen, das sich für unsere Akustiklösungen interessiert, und findest heraus, welche Anforderungen und Herausforderungen bestehen.
11:00 | Team-Austausch
Du stimmst dich mit dem Sales-Team zu laufenden Opportunities, Prioritäten und möglichen nächsten Schritten ab.
12:30 | Mittagspause
Gemeinsames Mittagessen in Berlin-Mitte – Pasta, Tacos oder dein persönlicher Klassiker.
14:00 | Produktdemo und Beratung
Du führst potenzielle Kund:innen durch unsere Produkte, beantwortest ihre Fragen und entwickelst die passende Lösung.
16:00 | Angebote und Follow-ups
Du erstellst ein Angebot, aktualisierst deine Pipeline und meldest dich bei deinen laufenden Opportunities.
18:00 | Feierabend
Deine Offline-Zeit respektieren wir.

Das bringst du mit
  • Du hast bereits Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, idealerweise in einem beratungsintensiven Sales-Umfeld.
  • Du fühlst dich im direkten Kundenkontakt wohl und kannst Bedürfnisse schnell verstehen.
  • Du führst strukturierte Discovery Calls und kannst Produkte überzeugend präsentieren.
  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Pipeline und bringst Deals zuverlässig zum Abschluss.
  • Du kommunizierst fließend auf Deutsch und sicher auf Englisch.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert.
  • Du hast Freude daran, gemeinsam mit einem ambitionierten Team zu wachsen.
  • Erfahrung mit physischen Produkten, Interior Design, Workplace Solutions oder einem vergleichbaren B2B-Umfeld ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.
Unser Bewerbungsprozess: schnell und transparentWir wissen, dass gute Kandidat:innen gefragt sind – deshalb lassen wir dich nicht wochenlang warten.
  1. The Spark: Ein kurzes Gespräch mit Lia, um herauszufinden, ob unsere, ob unsere Werte und Vorstellungen zusammenpassen.
  2. The Market Fit: Ein ausführlicheres Gespräch mit Alvaro und Jarno über deine Erfahrung, deinen Sales-Ansatz und die Rolle.
  3. The Commercial View: Ein Gespräch mit Leah über unsere Wachstumsstrategie und deine Rolle darin.
  4. The Live Action: Ein praxisnahes Rollenspiel mit dem Team – ohne Hausaufgabe und ohne tagelange Vorbereitung.
  5. The Vision: Ein finales Gespräch mit unserem CEO über deine Entwicklung und deinen möglichen Weg bei mute-labs.
Bereit, mehr Ruhe in die Arbeitswelt zu bringen?

THE JOB

Reading this to the end is worth it.

The Company: Why mute-labs?


mute-labs is the EU market leader in acoustic phone booths, with more than 20,000 cabins sold and counting. We are self-funded, profitable since day one, and have no investors to answer to and no exit to chase. What we do have is a steep growth curve in revenue, a product made in Germany, and a genuine mission: giving the modern office some quiet back.


We have built a strong direct and dealer business on the back of inbound demand and word of mouth. What we have not built yet is a real outbound engine for winning bigger accounts on purpose, from ambitious growth companies to household names like Volkswagen, adidas, IKEA, Red Bull, or Axel Springer, who already trust us today. That gap is this role, and how far into that world you grow is largely up to you.


Outbound is not a new idea for us. We have piloted it in smaller pockets already, testing signal-based outreach and structured sequences with real results. What has been missing is someone to own this as a dedicated motion for bigger accounts rather than a side project squeezed in between other things. That is why we are building this out as a new department and you’d be joining a small, yet focussed team as one of the first hires.


The Role: Build the Pipeline AND the Channel


This is a founding position. You are not stepping into an existing sales org with a quota handed down from three reps before you. You are the first one in the building. What you build, and how you build it, is largely up to you and your team, and you can grow the size and ambition of your target accounts as you find your footing.


  • Green Field, Full Ownership: Build your own pipeline from scratch. There is no inherited book of business and no recycled leads. The customer base you build is yours, and so is the revenue you generate from it.

  • Segment Strategy, Together: You understand the market as well as anyone. Rather than being handed a target list from above, you and your manager will decide together which segments and account types are worth focusing on.

  • Comp That Rewards More Than the First Deal: An uncapped bonus with a kicker for overperformance. Returning customers you bring in keep feeding your comp over time, not just the initial close. Landing an account well is worth more than landing it once.

  • A Brand That Opens Doors: You are not cold-calling on behalf of an unknown startup. mute-labs is an established, well-regarded market leader with a reference list that already includes some of the biggest names in German and European business. That credibility is yours to use from day one.

  • A seasoned team to back you up: Your manager has built and run outbound and enterprise sales hands-on, from cold pipeline to six-figure closes, and will work closely with you from day one, coaching, supporting, and training wherever it's actually needed rather than just checking in on numbers.


Is This You?


  • The Go-Getter: You do not wait to be told what to do next. You get on your feet quickly, figure out the shape of the problem, and start moving before anyone has to push you.

Die Rolle: Beratung statt einfach nur telefonieren

Bei uns liest Du kein vorgefertigtes Skript ab. Du berätst Unternehmen in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz dabei, bessere Arbeitswelten zu gestalten.

  • Qualifizierte Inbound Leads: Vergiss wahlloses „Smile and Dial“. Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für hochwertige Leads – Unternehmen, die bereits echtes Interesse an unseren Produkten haben.

  • Kein Ellenbogen-Sales: Bei uns gibt es keine Provision. Warum? Weil wir möchten, dass Du das tust, was für den Kunden und das Team am besten ist – nicht das, was Deinen Bonus maximiert. Stattdessen bieten wir ein wettbewerbsfähiges, stabiles Fixgehalt, weil wir auf Deine intrinsische Motivation setzen.
So könnte Dein Tag bei uns aussehen

Wir leben eine Office-First-Kultur. Wir glauben, dass die besten Sales-Ideen bei einem gemeinsamen Kaffee entstehen – und nicht in endlosen Slack-Threads.

  • 09:00 | Morning Vibe: Du kommst in unser energiegeladenes Office in Berlin-Mitte, holst Dir einen Kaffee, checkst die neuesten Leads und planst Deinen Tag.
  • 09:30 | Action Phase: Du bist am Telefon oder im Video-Call, sprichst mit neuen Leads über ihre Office-Herausforderungen und vereinbarst Demos.
  • 11:00 | Strategy Huddle: Kurzer Austausch mit Alvaro, unserem Country Manager, oder Jarno, unserem Sales Director, zu einem konkreten Deal oder einem Markttrend, den Du entdeckt hast.
  • 12:30 | Family Table: Wir essen gemeinsam. Freitags kocht ein Team für die ganze Firma. Ob Pasta, Tacos oder ein persönlicher Klassiker – beim gemeinsamen Mittagessen kommen wir als Team zusammen.
  • 14:30 | Market Mastery: Du führst Discovery Demos. Dabei hörst Du mehr zu, als Du redest, und findest heraus, wo beim Kunden wirklich der Schuh drückt.
  • 18:00 | The Close: Du bringst Dein CRM auf den neuesten Stand, aktualisierst Deine Pipeline und machst Feierabend. Deine Offline-Zeit respektieren wir.
Pulse & Pints Friday

Jeden Freitag lassen wir die Woche gemeinsam ausklingen.

  • The Pulse: In unserem Team-Huddle schauen wir auf die Zahlen, teilen Company Updates und feiern Kolleg:innen, die in dieser Woche besonders viel bewegt haben.
  • The Pints: Danach starten wir gemeinsam ins Wochenende – mit Drinks, alkoholisch oder 0,0 %, und dem guten Gefühl, gemeinsam etwas erreicht zu haben.
Unser Bewerbungsprozess: Schnell & transparent

Wir wissen, dass gute Kandidat:innen gefragt sind – deshalb lassen wir Dich nicht wochenlang warten.

  1. The Spark: Ein kurzer Screening Call mit Lia, um herauszufinden, ob unsere Werte und Vorstellungen zusammenpassen.
  2. The Market Fit: Ein Deep Dive mit Alvaro (Country Manager) und Jarno (Sales Director), bei dem es um Deine Sales-DNA geht.
  3. The Commercial View: Ein Gespräch mit Leah (Head of Commercial) über unsere Wachstumsstrategie und Deine Rolle darin.
  4. The Live Action: Ein Discovery Role Play mit dem Team. Keine Hausaufgabe, keine tagelange Vorbereitung – wir möchten einfach sehen, wie Du ein echtes Kundengespräch führst.

Erkennst Du Dich wieder?

Bereit, mehr Ruhe in die Arbeitswelt zu bringen?

Wenn Du nach einer Sales-Rolle suchst, in der Du als Profi behandelt wirst, von einem starken Team unterstützt wirst und in einer offenen, ambitionierten Office-Kultur arbeiten möchtest, dann wollen wir Dich kennenlernen.

Bewirb Dich jetzt – wir melden uns schneller bei Dir, als Du denkst!

Here at mute-labs, we aim to enable companies to achieve more by democratizing silence in the workspace. And we’re not like any other Berlin startup you might know:

title: SAP Account Executive (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Aufgaben

Du weißt, dass du zu den Besten gehörst.  Dein Umfeld weiß es auch.  Aber deine aktuelle Rolle gibt dir nicht mehr den Raum, den du verdienst.   Du hast in den letzten Jahren Deals geschlossen, die andere für unmöglich hielten. Du kennst das SAP-Ökosystem nicht aus Präsentationen – sondern aus echten Co-Sell-Gesprächen, aus Partnerverhandlungen, aus Abschlüssen, die du persönlich über die Linie gebracht hast.  Jetzt fragst du dich: Gibt es eine Rolle, die meinem Anspruch wirklich gerecht wird?   Die gibt es. Und du liest sie gerade. 

Die Rolle

 Dies ist eine reine New-Business-Position mit klarer strategischer Bedeutung für Implicos Wachstum in SAP-zentrierten Prozessindustrien. Du verantwortest die Gewinnung neuer Kundenlogos in den Segmenten Landwirtschaft, Bergbau, Chemie sowie Zement und Baustoffe – in enger Co-Sell-Partnerschaft mit SAP Account Teams und Industry Business Units.  Du bewegst dich in einem Umfeld, in dem Vertrauen, Substanz und Marktkenntnisse entscheiden – nicht Lautstärke. 
 
Deine Verantwortung

  • Vollständige Quota-Verantwortung für neues ARR aus Prozessindustrie-Kunden
  • Identifikation und Qualifizierung von Opportunities aus der SAP-ADRM-Pipeline sowie dem eigenen Netzwerk
  • Aufbau und Pflege belastbarer Co-Sell-Beziehungen mit SAP SCM Sales Reps und IBU-Kontakten
  • Steuerung komplexer Sales-Zyklen von 3–9 Monaten mit mehreren Entscheidungsträgern auf IT-, Operations- und C-Level-Ebene
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Solution Architects für technische Deep Dives und Proof-of-Value-Definitionen
  • Akkurate Pipeline-Führung im CRM sowie strukturiertes Forecasting
  • Kontinuierliche Rückmeldung von Markt- und Wettbewerbsinformationen an Product- und GTM-Teams


Dein Profil

Was wir voraussetzen:

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre B2B-Softwarevertrieb, davon mindestens 3 Jahre im SAP-Umfeld oder im strukturierten Co-Sell mit SAP
  • Nachweisliche Hunter-Bilanz: nachhaltig neue Kundenbeziehungen aufgebaut und abgeschlossen – nicht primär im Bestandsgeschäft
  • Tiefes Verständnis der SAP Channel- und Co-Sell-Mechanismen: Partnerdeals, RISE/GROW-Pipeline, SAP-Partnerökosystem
  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Multi-Stakeholder-Prozessen auf Entscheiderebene
  • Souveränes Auftreten auf C-Level – verbindlich, präzise, auf Augenhöhe
  • Ausgeprägte Eigenständigkeit in einem frühen, sich entwickelnden Go-to-Market-Setup
  • Verhandlungssichere Kenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch
Was dich zusätzlich auszeichnet:
  • Branchenwissen in Landwirtschaft, Bergbau, Chemie oder Zement/Baustoffe
  • Bestehendes Netzwerk in der SAP SCM- oder Logistik-IBU-Community
  • Erfahrung im Vertrieb von SAP-Add-ons oder SolEx-Produkten
  • Vertrautheit mit Supply-Chain-Execution-, TM- oder Bulk-Logistik-Prozessen
 
Was du bei uns findest
  • Eine strategisch bedeutsame Rolle mit direktem Einfluss auf das Unternehmenswachstum
  • Klare Ziele, volle Autonomie in der Ausführung – kein Mikromanagement
  • Ungedeckeltes Vergütungsmodell – dein Upside spiegelt deinen Beitrag
  • Direkter Zugang zum SAP-Ökosystem und enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Solution Architects
  • Ein Umfeld, das Seniorität respektiert und Eigenverantwortung erwartet
Du gestaltest – nicht nur mit. Du gestaltest, wie es wird.

 Implico ist kein fertig gebautes Konstrukt, das auf einen weiteren Vertriebsmitarbeiter wartet. Diese Rolle ist eine der ersten ihrer Art – du definierst mit, wie wir in den Prozessindustrien wahrgenommen werden, wie wir co-sellen, wie wir skalieren. Was du heute aufbaust, bleibt. Dein Fingerabdruck ist sichtbar – in der Kundenbasis, in der Marktpositionierung, in der Art, wie das Team in zwei Jahren arbeitet. Das ist kein Job. Das ist ein Gestaltungsauftrag.
 
Das Team – kein Versprechen, sondern eine Einladung.

 "Tolles Team" steht in jeder Stellenanzeige. Das überspringst du längst. Deshalb sagen wir es anders: Schau dir an, mit wem du zusammenarbeiten würdest.  Mark, Maurice, Anna, Thales, Selina und mehr. Menschen, die nicht wegen des Titels hier sind. Die morgens mit echtem Interesse an ihre Arbeit gehen. Die füreinander einspringen, ohne dass jemand fragen muss. Die über ihre Themen sprechen, als wären es ihre eigenen Projekte – weil sie es sind. Keine perfekte Hochglanz-Kultur. Aber eine, in der Leidenschaft und Haltung mehr zählen als Hierarchie.  Ob das zu dir passt? Das findest du nur heraus, wenn du das Gespräch suchst.
 
Der nächste Schritt

 Wenn du in den letzten Jahren bewiesen hast, dass du im SAP-Umfeld neue Märkte erschließt und Abschlüsse bringst dann freuen wir uns auf ein erstes, offenes Gespräch.  Kein langes Anschreiben. Zeig uns deinen Track Record – der Rest ergibt sich.

title: Dealer Account Manager
description:
About AIM Intelligent Machines

AIM Intelligent Machines is pioneering the future of heavy equipment automation. Our technology enables a single operator to monitor and control multiple machines simultaneously—dramatically improving productivity, reducing labor costs, and reshaping what's possible in construction, mining, and industrial operations.

Through cutting-edge AI, computer vision, and robotics, AIM is solving critical challenges in equipment autonomy and remote operations. We're building systems that augment human capability—allowing people to do more with less, safely and efficiently.

We are growing quickly and looking for experienced, motivated Account Managers to accelerate adoption of our solutions by building strong partnerships and cultivating strategic customer relationships.

 

Position Summary

As Dealer Account Manager, you will play a pivotal role in scaling AIM’s groundbreaking heavy equipment automation platform. You’ll be responsible for growing revenue through both channel partners and direct key accounts, with a clear focus on companies looking to deploy machine automation that allows one operator to manage fleets of equipment.

You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams—including sales leadership, product, and engineering—to help customers modernize their operations and gain a competitive edge through AIM’s autonomous systems.

 

Key Responsibilities

Channel Partner Management

  • Build and grow relationships with channel partners (resellers, OEMs, system integrators) to drive adoption of AIM’s automation platform.

  • Enable and train partners to sell AIM solutions focused on multi-machine control and operator augmentation.

  • Monitor partner performance and support business planning to meet joint sales targets.

  • Identify new partners in strategic markets (construction, mining, landfill and quarry environments.

 

Key Account Management

  • Identify and engage high-potential enterprise accounts seeking to modernize heavy equipment operations through automation, specifically in the mining, landfill and quarry markets.

  • Understand customer workflows and pain points, and position AIM’s multi-machine control solutions as a strategic advantage.

  • Lead the sales process from discovery through close, with support from technical teams.

  • Maintain strong post-sale relationships to drive expansion and long-term success.

 

Internal Collaboration

  • Work with marketing to create partner- and industry-specific messaging and campaigns.

  • Partner with product teams to communicate market feedback and help shape feature development

  • Maintain accurate CRM records, pipeline forecasts, and performance metrics.

 

Qualifications & Skills

  • 3–7 years of experience in B2B sales, account management, or channel sales—preferably in earthworks tech, industrial ground engagement automation, and heavy machinery.

  • Experience selling or supporting technology that transforms field operations or operator workflows.

  • Strong understanding of the construction or mining ecosystem—including OEMs, contractors, equipment dealers, and tech providers.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.

  • Self-starter with the ability to operate in a fast-moving, highly innovative environment.

  • Comfortable with travel (30–50%) to partner/customer sites and industry events.

 

Why Join AIM?

  • Solve a massive set of real-world problems that require scalable earth moving

  • Accomplish that via deploying and expanding cutting edge tech

  • Run your workstreams with the largest degree of autonomy

  • Have an opportunity for rapid growth and a large voice on the direction of the company

  • Receive company funded medical, dental, vision, 401k, life insurance, gourmet food & perks

  • Experience a strong onsite collaboration (AIM offices, labs and proving grounds on the east side of the Greater Seattle area)

  • Have an opportunity to travel to unique sites around the world (Americas, Australia, Africa & more)

title: AI Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Karriere

Wir suchen erfahrene AI Engineers, die KI nicht nur demonstrieren, sondern produktiv bekommen – als Teil komplexer Business-Anwendungen, die im Alltag unserer Kunden tragen müssen. Du bist Softwareentwickler mit echter Engineering-Tiefe, idealerweise mit Full-Stack-Erfahrung, und du bewegst dich sicher in Cloud-Umgebungen wie AWS und/oder Azure. Du denkst LLMs, Agenten und datengetriebene Services von Anfang an mit – und weißt, wo sie fachlich sinnvoll sind und wo nicht.

Ein Schwerpunkt liegt für uns im Agentic Engineering: Systeme, die nicht nur antworten, sondern handeln – mit Tool-Zugriff, mehrstufigen Abläufen, Zustand, Fehlerbehandlung und klar definierten Grenzen. Genau hier trennt sich der Prototyp von der Lösung, die man einem Kunden guten Gewissens übergibt. Und genau hier brauchen wir Leute, die beides können: Modelle verstehen und robuste Software bauen.

Wichtig ist uns: Diese Rolle bleibt hands-on. Du baust selbst, du deployst selbst, du debuggst selbst. 

Bei nerdware steht nicht nur der Code im Mittelpunkt, sondern vor allem der Mensch dahinter. Die beste technische Lösung entsteht dort, wo Teamgeist, offene Kommunikation und gegenseitiges Vertrauen gelebt werden. Wenn du menschlich zu uns passt, hast du den wichtigsten Schritt bereits gemacht.

Wir arbeiten in einem Feld, das sich schneller verändert als jedes andere in der Softwareentwicklung. Deshalb suchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, neugierig bleiben und Hype von Substanz unterscheiden können.   • Agentic Engineering: Entwurf und Umsetzung agentischer Systeme – Tool- und Function-Calling, Orchestrierung mehrstufiger Workflows, Kontext- und State-Management, Retries und Fallbacks, Human-in-the-Loop und sinnvolle Guardrails
  • Design und Umsetzung von LLM-Anwendungen: RAG-Pipelines, strukturierte Extraktion, Evaluation, Observability

Dein Profil

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit LLMs und generativer KI in echten Projekten: Prompting, RAG, Embeddings/Vektor-Datenbanken, Function Calling, Fine-Tuning oder Agenten-Frameworks.

  • Solides Verständnis von ML-Grundlagen und Datenverarbeitung – du weißt, was ein Modell leisten kann und wo seine Grenzen liegen
